title: MC-EvoBench: Auditing Experience-Driven Self-Improvement in Minecraft Agents
title_zh: MC-EvoBench：审查 Minecraft 智能体中的经验驱动型自我改进

paragraphs.en: A central challenge in embodied recursive self-improvement is enabling agents to convert interaction history into capabilities that persist beyond one world and transfer to later tasks. A saved memory or successful final action does not by itself establish that a reusable capability was acquired; evaluation must separate capability change from carried-over resources, unequal source exposure, and early execution failures. We construct MC-EvoBench as a controlled Minecraft benchmark with a fixed catalog of 19 registered evolution chains, including 12 primary evaluation chains and seven calibration or probe chains, together with three graph-aligned paired probe families for transfer. The benchmark represents each task as a task-state graph, defines stage-level environment verifiers, assigns matched source and target roles, resets the target world, and permits only a declared agent artifact to cross the source–target boundary. For each probe, no-prior, related, unrelated, and shuffled source conditions are evaluated under matched environment-step budgets and five seeds; we report TSR, WGP, and VMP and retain provenance records. The benchmark reveals a consistent direct-capability gap between controller and planner-backed variants, while related experience yields no stable transfer: it does not improve either tool probe, its small wood-species gain hinges on one seed, and all intervals include zero. Stage audits further show that early wood-collection and crafting bottlenecks often leave later capabilities unobserved. MC-EvoBench thus offers a controlled testbed for durable, transferable embodied capabilities. Code and data are available at https://github.com/xzw-ustc/mc-bench-open-source .
paragraphs.zh: 具身递归自我改进的一个核心挑战，是使智能体能够将交互历史转化为超越单个世界并迁移到后续任务的能力。 保存的记忆或成功的最终行动本身并不能证明已获得了可重用的能力；评估必须将能力的变化与资源延续、来源暴露不均以及早期执行失败区分开来。 我们构建了 MC-EvoBench，这是一个受控的 Minecraft 基准测试，包含一个由 19 条已注册进化链组成的固定目录，其中包括 12 条主要评估链和 7 条校准或探测链，以及用于迁移的三条图对齐的成对探测族。 该基准测试将每个任务表示为任务状态图，定义了阶段级环境验证器，分配了匹配的来源和目标角色，重置了目标世界，并且只允许声明的智能体产物穿越来源与目标之间的边界。 对于每条探测链，我们在匹配的环境步数预算和五个种子条件下评估了无先验、相关、无关和打乱的来源条件；我们报告了 TSR、WGP 和 VMP，并保留了来源记录。 该基准测试揭示了控制器和规划器支持的变体之间存在持续的直接能力差距，而相关经验并未带来稳定的迁移：它未能提升任何工具探测链，其微弱的木材种类增益仅依赖于一个种子，且所有区间都包含零值。 阶段审计进一步表明，早期的木材收集和制作瓶颈常常导致后续能力未被观察到。 因此，MC-EvoBench 提供了一个用于测试持久、可迁移的具身能力的受控实验平台。 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/xzw-ustc/mc-bench-open-source 获取。

paragraphs.en: One of the central ambitions of autonomous intelligence is recursive self-improvement (RSI) ( Chen et al., 2026 ) : an agent should use experience from its own actions to become more capable over time. The goal is larger than learning one policy or storing one successful trajectory. An RSI system should turn experience into a capability, retain it, and apply it when the task, world, or required action changes. This loop is central to long-horizon autonomy: as tasks become harder, the agent must build on what it has already learned.
paragraphs.zh: 自主智能的核心目标之一是递归自我改进（RSI）（Chen 等，2026）：智能体应利用自身行动获得的经验，随着时间的推移不断提升能力。 这一目标超越了学习单一策略或存储单一成功轨迹的范畴。 RSI 系统应将经验转化为能力，将其保留下来，并在任务、世界或所需行动发生变化时加以应用。 这一循环是长期自主性的核心：随着任务难度增加，智能体必须在其已有知识的基础上继续发展。

sents.zh: 这一循环是长期自主性的核心：随着任务难度增加，智能体必须在其已有知识的基础上继续发展。

paragraphs.en: This view differs from evaluation settings in which training is separated from testing and improvement is summarized by a single score ( Ren et al., 2026 ) . For RSI, the important question is whether a gain remains useful after the original interaction has ended. A capability should survive a change in local conditions, help with a related goal, and combine with actions that were not part of the source task. RSI is therefore a systems problem: learning, memory, planning, and physical interaction must work together, while the resulting gain remains visible and attributable.
paragraphs.zh: 这种观点不同于那些将训练与测试分离、并通过单一分数来概括改进效果的评价设置（Ren 等人，2026）。 对于 RSI 而言，关键问题是：在原始互动结束后，所获得的增益是否仍然有用。 一项能力应当能够在局部条件变化后依然有效，有助于实现相关目标，并且能够与源任务中未包含的动作相结合。 因此，RSI 是一个系统性问题：学习、记忆、规划和物理互动必须协同工作，同时所产生的增益必须保持可观察且可归因。

paragraphs.en: Embodied agents make this problem concrete and difficult. Their behavior depends on both internal state and physical state. A later success may reflect a tool left in the inventory, a changed world, a favorable location, or more source interaction rather than a reusable capability. A useful benchmark must therefore show that improvement survives a reset and appears in observable behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 具身智能体使这个问题变得具体而困难。 它们的行为既取决于内部状态，也取决于物理状态。 后来的成功可能反映的是工具仍留在库存中、世界发生了变化、位置有利，或者与源头的互动更多，而不是某种可重复使用的能力。 因此，一个有用的基准必须能够证明，在重置之后，这种改进仍然存在，并且体现在可观察的行为中。

sents.en: Embodied agents make this problem concrete and difficult.
sents.zh: 具身智能体使这个问题变得具体而困难。

sents.en: Their behavior depends on both internal state and physical state.
sents.zh: 它们的行为既取决于内部状态，也取决于物理状态。

sents.zh: 因此，一个有用的基准必须能够证明，在重置之后，这种改进仍然存在，并且体现在可观察的行为中。

paragraphs.en: We study this question through later behavior. A memory, skill file, or model update shows that an agent changed internally. It does not show that the agent gained a useful capability ( Li et al., 2025b ; Park et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . The evidence must link internal change to later action. It must also distinguish capability from favorable execution. To test that claim, we compare target behavior after a world reset and check both task outcomes and stage-level records.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过后续行为来研究这个问题。 记忆、技能文件或模型更新表明，智能体内部发生了变化。 但这并不能说明该智能体获得了有用的能力（Li et al., 2025b；Park et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026）。 证据必须将内部变化与后续行动联系起来。 此外，还必须区分能力与有利的执行效果。 为了验证这一主张，我们比较了世界重置后的目标行为，并检查任务结果和阶段级记录。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks address parts of this problem. MCU ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) evaluates diverse and combined Minecraft tasks with automatic verification. LifelongAgentBench ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , EvoAgentBench ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , and PAST-Bench ( Xue et al., 2026 ) study learning across tasks, transfer, and persistent state in other settings. Embodied evaluation also needs to separate world resources from agent state, match source budgets, and record where a task chain fails ( Ni et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . Otherwise, a score difference may reflect an easier world, more source interaction, or an early failure that hides later behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试仅解决了该问题的一部分。 MCU（Zheng 等人，2023）通过自动验证评估了多样化且组合的 Minecraft 任务。 LifelongAgentBench（Zheng 等人，2025）、EvoAgentBench（Gao 等人，2026）和 PAST-Bench（Xue 等人，2026）研究了其他场景下跨任务学习、知识迁移和持久状态的问题。 具身评估还需要将世界资源与智能体状态分离，匹配源预算，并记录任务链失败的位置（Ni 等人，2025；Cheng 等人，2026；Luo 等人，2025）。 否则，分数差异可能反映的是更简单的世界、更多的源交互，或是掩盖了后续行为的早期失败。

paragraphs.en: Minecraft makes these controls practical. Collecting resources, crafting tools, and using them create visible task dependencies. A task-state graph represents these relations, and environment evidence verifies each stage. Resetting the world and inventory removes physical carryover, while stage records show progress before a chain stops ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 《我的世界》使这些控制变得实用。 收集资源、制作工具并使用它们，会形成可见的任务依赖关系。 任务状态图表示这些关系，而环境证据则验证每个阶段。 重置世界和物品栏会清除物理上的延续性，而阶段记录则显示在链条中断前的进展（Guo et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Minecraft makes these controls practical.
sents.zh: 《我的世界》使这些控制变得实用。

sents.zh: 收集资源、制作工具并使用它们，会形成可见的任务依赖关系。

sents.zh: 任务状态图表示这些关系，而环境证据则验证每个阶段。

sents.en: Resetting the world and inventory removes physical carryover, while stage records show progress before a chain stops ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: We introduce MC-EvoBench to evaluate embodied RSI in Minecraft. Figure 1 shows its mechanism: measure progress, transfer only a declared agent artifact, and use matched controls to assess experience gains. Table 1 compares this design with representative Minecraft benchmarks ( Guss et al., 2019 ; Fan et al., 2022 ; Hill et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . MC-EvoBench provides a task catalog, verifiers, and three short probe families for wood-species crafting, wooden-tool transfer, and stone-tool transfer. The framework can study capability formation, transfer, retention, and composition. This paper focuses on forward transfer between graph-related tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MC-EvoBench，用于评估 Minecraft 中的具身 RSI。 图 1 展示了其机制：衡量进展、仅传输已声明的智能体产物，并使用匹配的控制组来评估经验增益。 表 1 将此设计与代表性的 Minecraft 基准测试进行了比较（Guss 等人，2019；Fan 等人，2022；Hill 等人，2023；Wang 等人，2025）。 MC-EvoBench 提供了一个任务目录、验证器以及三个简短的探测任务系列，分别用于木材种类制作、木制工具迁移和石制工具迁移。 该框架可用于研究能力的形成、迁移、保持与组合。 本文重点关注图相关任务之间的正向迁移。

paragraphs.en: Embodied RSI as attributable capability change. We formalize an agent as a policy, a persistent state, and an update rule, and separate this persistent state from the world state. A gain counts as experience-driven only when it appears after the target world is reset, only a declared artifact crosses the source–target boundary, and matched unrelated and shuffled sources rule out alternative explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 将具身 RSI 视为可归因的能力变化。 我们将智能体形式化为一个策略、一个持久状态和一个更新规则，并将这个持久状态与世界状态区分开来。 只有当增益出现在目标世界重置之后，只有当已声明的人工制品跨越了源-目标边界，并且匹配的不相关且打乱的源排除了其他解释时，该增益才被视为经验驱动。

sents.en: We formalize an agent as a policy, a persistent state, and an update rule, and separate this persistent state from the world state.
sents.zh: 我们将智能体形式化为一个策略、一个持久状态和一个更新规则，并将这个持久状态与世界状态区分开来。

sents.en: A gain counts as experience-driven only when it appears after the target world is reset, only a declared artifact crosses the source–target boundary, and matched unrelated and shuffled sources rule out alternative explanations.
sents.zh: 只有当增益出现在目标世界重置之后，只有当已声明的人工制品跨越了源-目标边界，并且匹配的不相关且打乱的源排除了其他解释时，该增益才被视为经验驱动。

paragraphs.en: MC-EvoBench, an executable audit of experience-driven improvement. It instantiates this definition in Minecraft with a task-state graph of 80 tasks, 111 states, and 369 typed edges organized into 19 chains; stage-level verifiers with three complementary metrics, Task Success Rate (TSR), Weighted Graph Progress (WGP), and Verified Milestone Progress (VMP); and a four-condition paired protocol with matched environment-step budgets and provenance records.
paragraphs.zh: MC-EvoBench，一项对经验驱动改进的可执行审计。 它在《我的世界》中具体化了这一定义，构建了一个包含 80 个任务、111 个状态和 369 条类型化边的任务状态图，这些边被组织成 19 条链；同时配备了阶段级验证器，采用三种互补的指标：任务成功率（TSR）、加权图进展（WGP）和已验证里程碑进展（VMP）；以及一个包含四种条件的配对协议，该协议具有匹配的环境步数预算和来源记录。

paragraphs.en: Controlled evidence on embodied transfer. Controller-based agents clearly outperform planner-backed variants in direct capability. Under matched controls, the reference method shows no stable transfer gain, even though its related sources earn more verified progress and, on the longer probes, more computation, and early wood-collection and crafting bottlenecks leave later capabilities unobserved. Future RSI methods must therefore first clear these execution bottlenecks, and their gains should be claimed only after a controlled audit.
paragraphs.zh: 关于具身迁移的受控证据。 基于控制器的智能体在直接能力方面明显优于依赖规划器的变体。 在匹配的控制条件下，参考方法并未表现出稳定的迁移增益，尽管其相关来源获得了更多经过验证的进展，并且在更长的探测任务中消耗了更多计算资源；此外，早期的木材收集与制作瓶颈导致后续能力未被观察到。 因此，未来的 RSI 方法必须首先解决这些执行瓶颈，并且只有在经过受控审计之后，才能声称其增益。

paragraphs.en: Minecraft combines visual control, persistent resources, and tasks with many prerequisites. MineDojo provides a large open-world task collection and a knowledge base that supports broad embodied-agent research ( Fan et al., 2022 ) . BEDD extends MineRL ( Guss et al., 2019 ) with demonstrations and evaluation for tasks whose success can be difficult to describe with a single exact goal. MinePlanner focuses on long-horizon planning in large Minecraft worlds, while OpenHA studies open-source hierarchical agents and their execution in the same environment ( Hill et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Voyager uses a curriculum, a skill library, and environment feedback for continued exploration and skill reuse, including in a new world ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . MCU evaluates a broad set of tasks, their combinations, and automatic assessment ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Together, these benchmarks cover open-world interaction, planning, task diversity, and automatic verification. They do not, however, isolate whether a controlled source interaction causes a later improvement after the target world is reset.
paragraphs.zh: 《我的世界》结合了视觉控制、持久性资源以及具有多种前提条件的任务。 MineDojo 提供了一个大型开放世界任务集和一个支持广泛具身智能体研究的知识库（Fan et al., 2022）。 BEDD 在 MineRL（Guss et al., 2019）的基础上增加了演示和评估功能，适用于那些成功与否难以用单一明确目标来描述的任务。 MinePlanner 专注于大型《我的世界》世界中的长期规划，而 OpenHA 则研究开源分层智能体及其在同一环境中的执行（Hill et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2025）。 Voyager 利用课程安排、技能库和环境反馈来实现持续探索与技能复用，包括在新世界中也是如此（Wang et al., 2023）。 MCU 评估了广泛的任务集、它们的组合以及自动评估方法（Zheng et al., 2023）。 这些基准测试共同涵盖了开放世界交互、规划、任务多样性和自动验证。 然而，它们并未单独检验受控的源环境交互是否在目标世界重置后引发了后续的提升。

paragraphs.en: Several recent benchmarks study improvement across tasks and the use of stored experience. LifelongAgentBench tests skill gain, retention, and transfer across databases, operating systems, and knowledge graphs ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . EvoAgentBench uses agent traces to identify abilities and groups tasks by shared procedures, making transfer between related tasks explicit ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . PAST-Bench compares runs with and without persistent state and tracks how experience is saved and reused in personal-agent settings ( Xue et al., 2026 ) . These studies establish useful ideas for measuring persistence and transfer, but their tasks do not expose the same physical-state confounds as embodied environments. In Minecraft, an apparent gain can instead come from a carried tool, a modified world, or a different starting location. MC-EvoBench addresses this boundary by resetting inventory and world changes while allowing only a declared agent artifact to transfer. Its task-state graph makes prerequisites and progress visible.
paragraphs.zh: 近期多项基准研究探讨了跨任务的性能提升以及存储经验的应用。 LifelongAgentBench 测试了智能体在不同数据库、操作系统和知识图谱中的技能获取、保持与迁移能力（Zheng 等，2025）。 EvoAgentBench 利用智能体轨迹识别其能力，并根据共享流程对任务进行分组，从而明确相关任务之间的迁移关系（Gao 等，2026）。 PAST-Bench 对比了使用与不使用持久状态的运行结果，并追踪了个人智能体设置中经验的存储与复用方式（Xue 等，2026）。 这些研究为衡量持久性与迁移性提供了有价值的思路，但其任务并未暴露出具身环境中相同的物理状态干扰因素。 在《我的世界》中，看似的能力提升实际上可能源于携带的工具、被修改的世界或不同的初始位置。 MC-EvoBench 通过重置物品栏和世界变化，同时仅允许声明的智能体产物进行迁移，从而解决了这一边界问题。 其任务状态图使前提条件和进度可视化。

paragraphs.en: Memory systems provide a practical mechanism for experience-driven improvement. Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) stores language feedback from failed attempts and uses it to guide later decisions. Agent Workflow Memory extracts reusable procedures from interaction traces for later tasks ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Skill libraries and model updates offer related ways to preserve information beyond a single episode. These methods show how an agent can store and retrieve experience, but reuse alone does not establish that a capability transferred. MC-EvoBench treats experience-driven improvement as an attribution problem. It separates source and target episodes, resets the physical state, and transfers only a declared artifact. Matched source conditions, verifier predicates, and stage records distinguish capability transfer from carried-over resources and partial execution.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆系统为经验驱动的提升提供了一种实用机制。 Reflexion（Shinn 等人，2023）会存储失败尝试中的语言反馈，并利用其指导后续决策。 Agent Workflow Memory 会从交互痕迹中提取可重用的流程，用于后续任务（Wang 等人，2026）。 技能库和模型更新提供了相关方法，可将信息保留在单个回合之外。 这些方法展示了智能体如何存储和检索经验，但仅靠重用本身并不能证明能力已实现转移。 MC-EvoBench 将经验驱动的提升视为一个归因问题。 它分离了源回合和目标回合，重置物理状态，并且只转移明确声明的产物。 匹配的源条件、验证谓词和阶段记录，能够将能力转移与资源继承或部分执行区分开来。

paragraphs.en: World state includes inventory, tools, resources, position, terrain, and world changes. Persistent agent state may include memories, prompts, replay data, checkpoints, or model updates. Every target run starts with the same registered world and inventory settings. Thus, source tools and world changes cannot explain a target score difference. A stored artifact provides evidence of a gain only when the target verifier also records a change in behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 世界状态包括物品清单、工具、资源、位置、地形以及世界变化。 持久化的智能体状态可能包含记忆、提示、重播数据、检查点或模型更新。 每次目标运行都以相同已注册的世界和物品清单设置开始。 因此，源工具和世界变化无法解释目标得分的差异。 只有当目标验证者也记录到行为变化时，存储的产物才能证明存在收益。

paragraphs.en: MC-EvoBench implements this framework in Minecraft with a fixed task catalog, verifiers, probe profiles, and observation interface. A change to any of these components defines a new benchmark version. The same evaluation can therefore test different ways of storing experience, such as textual memories, skill libraries, prompts, or model updates, under a shared task and evidence specification.
paragraphs.zh: MC-EvoBench 在《我的世界》中实现了这一框架，并配备了固定的任务目录、验证器、探测配置文件和观察接口。 对其中任何组件的修改都会定义一个新的基准测试版本。 因此，相同的评估可以在共享的任务和证据规范下，测试存储经验的不同方式，例如文本记忆、技能库、提示或模型更新。

paragraphs.en: We report two complementary views of the benchmark. The direct capability matrix measures immediate performance across the registered catalog without a source–target transfer claim. The paired probes then test whether a declared source artifact changes behavior on a later target after the world is reset. Keeping these views separate distinguishes basic execution ability from experience-driven improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了该基准测试的两个互补视角。 直接能力矩阵衡量注册目录中各项任务的即时表现，而无需声称存在源-目标转换。 随后，成对探针会检验：在环境重置后，一个已声明的源工件在后续目标任务上的行为是否发生变化。 保持这些视角的分离，有助于区分基础执行能力与经验驱动的提升。

paragraphs.en: The paired evaluation uses three probe families: wood-species crafting, wooden-tool transfer, and stone-tool transfer. Each family uses five paired agent seeds and four target conditions: no prior, related experience, unrelated experience, and shuffled related experience. Every target starts from the same world and inventory state for its family. Only the declared agent artifact may cross the source–target boundary. We report TSR, WGP, and VMP as defined in Section 3.3 . Source exposure is matched within each family; planner calls and token usage are recorded separately because equal environment exposure does not imply equal computation.

paragraphs.en: Controller-based execution clearly outperforms planner-backed execution. STEVE-1 ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ) and the controller-only JARVIS-1 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and Optimus-1 ( Li et al., 2024 ) variants reach average TSR/WGP/VMP of 8.4/6.4/25.5, 7.5/5.5/25.0, and 8.1/6.1/25.4, with the largest margins on the core and catalog-transfer partitions, where progress requires several dependent actions. The no-op baseline and the GPT-planned JARVIS-1 remain at the execution floor, confirming that the benchmark separates active task solving from background behavior. No planner dominates all three metrics: DeepSeek gives the highest average TSR for both JARVIS-1 (2.8) and Optimus-1 (4.9), whereas the highest VMP comes from DeepSeek for JARVIS-1 (6.0) but from GLM for Optimus-1 (12.5). The official VPT ( Baker et al., 2022 ) foundation weights improve over the STEVE-1 checkpoint (average VMP 10.4 versus 3.2) but remain below the controller variants.
paragraphs.zh: 基于控制器的执行方式明显优于依赖规划器的执行方式。 STEVE-1（Lifshitz 等，2023）、仅使用控制器的 JARVIS-1（Wang 等，2024）以及 Optimus-1（Li 等，2024）变体分别达到了平均 TSR/WGP/VMP 为 8.4/6.4/25.5、7.5/5.5/25.0 和 8.1/6.1/25.4，其中核心和目录转移分区上的差距最大，因为在此类任务中，进展需要执行多个依赖动作。 无操作基线以及 GPT 规划的 JARVIS-1 仍停留在执行基准水平，这证实了该基准测试能够区分主动任务解决与背景行为。 没有任何一种规划器在所有三项指标上均占主导地位：DeepSeek 在 JARVIS-1（2.8）和 Optimus-1（4.9）中均获得了最高的平均 TSR，而最高的 VMP 则分别来自 JARVIS-1 的 DeepSeek（6.0）和 Optimus-1 的 GLM（12.5）。 官方 VPT（Baker 等，2022）基础权重相较于 STEVE-1 检查点有所提升（平均 VMP 从 3.2 提升至 10.4），但仍低于使用控制器的变体。

paragraphs.en: In the failure-stage audit of the 57 direct-matrix reports per configuration (Figure 3 a), attrition concentrates in the first crafting steps: of the 42 reports that include wood collection, the three controller variants bring 20–23 to plank crafting, at most 14 to sticks, and at most 2 to the crafting table, while the Optimus-3 ( Li et al., 2025a ) action path never passes the initial wood stage. A low final score can therefore reflect an early execution bottleneck rather than the failure of a later capability, which remains unobserved. Per-seed effects ( Figure 3 b–c ) vary most for wood species, where the small positive mean GATG ( + 0.050 +0.050 ) is driven by a single seed ( + 1.0 +1.0 ) and falls to − 0.19 -0.19 without it; the tool probes vary less and have GATG means near zero. All three intervals cross zero, consistent with Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 在每种配置下 57 份直接矩阵报告的失败阶段审计中（图 3a），资源流失主要集中在最初的制作步骤：在包含木材采集的 42 份报告中，三种控制器变体可将木材转化为木板 20–23 份，最多可转化为木棍 14 份，最多可转化为制作台物品 2 份；而 Optimus-3（Li et al., 2025a）的行动路径从未通过最初的木材阶段。 因此，较低的最终分数可能反映的是早期执行中的瓶颈，而非后期能力的失败，而后者则未被观察到。 按种子划分的效应（图 3b–c）在木材种类上的差异最大：其中较小的正 GATG 均值（+0.050 +0.050）由单个种子（+1.0 +1.0）驱动，若没有该种子则降至 −0.19 -0.19；工具探测的变异较小，其 GATG 均值接近于零。 所有三个区间都穿过零值，这与表 4 的结果一致。

sents.en: A low final score can therefore reflect an early execution bottleneck rather than the failure of a later capability, which remains unobserved.

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the direct matrix measures immediate capability rather than transfer, and the paired probes should be read against its low execution floor. Under the current public instances, seeds, budgets, and reference method, related experience does not produce a stable positive transfer effect; this does not rule out gains under a different agent, artifact, task distribution, or source budget. Appendices C.3 , D.6 , and E.4 give the stage records, paired-reporting rules, and configuration fields needed to reproduce these comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，直接矩阵衡量的是即时能力而非迁移能力，而配对探针则应结合其较低的执行基准进行解读。 在当前公开的实例、种子、预算和参考方法下，相关经验并未产生稳定的正向迁移效应；但这并不排除在智能体、人工制品、任务分布或源预算不同情况下可能存在的增益。 附录 C.3、D.6 和 E.4 提供了重现这些比较所需的阶段记录、配对报告规则以及配置字段。

paragraphs.en: We introduced MC-EvoBench, a controlled Minecraft benchmark for auditing whether experience yields durable and transferable embodied capabilities. Its task-state graph, stage-level verifiers, and paired reset-target protocol with matched control sources separate capability change from carried-over resources, unequal exposure, and early execution failures. In the reference study, controller-based agents clearly outperform planner-backed variants, yet the reference method gains no stable target benefit from related experience: the only positive contrast, on wood species, is driven by a single seed, and all intervals include zero even though related sources earn more verified progress and, on the longer probes, more computation. Most runs also end before crafting sticks, leaving later capabilities unobserved. These conclusions are limited to the tested agents, probes, seeds, and budgets; retention, composition, stronger agents, and more seeds are natural next steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MC-EvoBench，这是一个受控的 Minecraft 基准测试，用于审计经验是否能够产生持久且可迁移的具身能力。 其任务状态图、阶段级验证器，以及与匹配控制源配对的重置-目标协议，能够将能力变化与资源延续、暴露不均及早期执行失败区分开来。 在参考研究中，基于控制器的智能体明显优于规划器支持的变体，但参考方法并未从相关经验中获得稳定的目标收益：唯一在木材种类上的积极对比是由单个种子驱动的，且所有区间都包含零值，尽管相关来源获得了更多经过验证的进展，并在更长的探测中消耗了更多计算资源。 大多数运行也结束于制作木棍之前，导致后续能力未被观察到。 这些结论仅限于所测试的智能体、探测项、种子和预算；保留性、组合性、更强智能体以及更多种子是自然的后续步骤。

paragraphs.en: This work evaluates agents in a virtual Minecraft environment. It does not involve human participants, personal data, or physical-world experiments. We use environment states and agent interaction traces to measure task execution and experience transfer. The results apply to the tested methods, tasks, environments, and budgets. They do not establish that these agents are safe or capable in real-world settings.

paragraphs.en: The primary environment is Minecraft 1.16.5 through MineRL, with a custom survival specification named MCBenchHumanSurvival-v0 . It extends the HumanSurvival environment with observations for inventory, local resources, world conditions, and task events. The agent interacts with the game through an adapter, while a separate evaluator converts the environment response into a normalized observation snapshot. This separation supports a common task definition across agents with different planning and control architectures.

paragraphs.en: The catalog distinguishes native_perception and structured_state observation sources. Each source records a path, its primary or diagnostic role, its interpretation, and an access declaration. Inventory, equipment, and basic survival measurements are examples of declared agent-visible sources. Local block counts, mission flags, kill counters, and world-light diagnostics are classified as structured evidence. RGB-based and structured-state methods therefore remain distinguishable even when they share the same task verifier.

paragraphs.en: The chain specification selects either a task-level or chain-level profile policy. Under the task-level policy, the runner selects each task’s profile; with the default per-stage reset setting, a profile change causes an environment reset. Under the chain-level policy, one selected profile governs the chain. Consecutive stages that remain in the same environment can reuse world resources and inventory, making state continuity an explicit part of chain evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 链式规范会选择任务级或链式级的配置文件策略。 在任务级策略下，执行器会为每个任务选择配置文件；根据默认的每阶段重置设置，配置文件变更将导致环境重置。 在链式级策略下，一个选定的配置文件将控制整个链式流程。 连续处于同一环境中的阶段可以重复使用世界资源和库存，使状态连续性成为链式评估的明确组成部分。

paragraphs.en: This within-chain continuity is separate from the source-to-target boundary. A target transfer evaluation starts from its prescribed environment state and receives only the permitted persistent artifact. A tool retained between two stages changes their execution conditions; a tool reconstructed after a target reset provides evidence about execution under the retained agent state. The protocol records these two situations separately.

paragraphs.en: A task is a compact executable contract: an identifier, an instruction, a domain, a step budget, an environment profile, a success specification, and observation-source declarations. paragraphs.en: Resource progression chains connect acquisition to increasingly demanding use. For example, the ore progression chain moves through wood preparation, basic tools, stone tools, ore collection, smelting, and higher-tier mining. Cross-domain chains join heterogeneous endpoints: locating coal, obtaining fuel, creating illumination, building shelter, and remaining alive, or preparing a weapon before a combat event. Transfer chains substitute wood species, tool recipes, or item roles while retaining comparable dependency patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 资源进阶链将资源的获取与日益严苛的使用需求连接起来。 例如，矿石进阶链依次经过木材准备、基础工具、石制工具、矿石采集、熔炼以及更高级别的采矿阶段。 跨领域链将异质的终点环节连接起来：寻找煤炭、获取燃料、制造照明、建造庇护所并维持生存，或在战斗事件发生前准备武器。 转移链通过替换木材种类、工具配方或物品角色，同时保留相似的依赖模式。

paragraphs.en: A completed possession task establishes its predicate at that stage. If the same item remains in inventory, a later occurrence with the same predicate may pass immediately. The ordered stage record makes this behavior explicit: initial-state passes have zero action steps, while newly acquired items appear in the observed state transition. Composition is consequently described through stage outcomes and state continuity, with experience transfer assessed by the reset protocol in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 一个完成的占有任务会在该阶段确立其谓词。 如果同一物品仍保留在库存中，后续出现具有相同谓词的情况可能会立即通过。 有序的阶段记录使这种行为变得明确：初始状态的通过没有操作步骤，而新获取的物品会出现在观察到的状态转换中。 因此，组合是通过阶段结果和状态连续性来描述的，而经验转移则通过附录 D 中的重置协议进行评估。

paragraphs.en: A new task can be added by defining its instruction and measurable endpoint, identifying the required observation channels, selecting an environment profile, and attaching its graph relations. paragraphs.en: MC-EvoBench evaluates success from environment observations. A task contains a conjunction of predicates, with optional disjunctive subexpressions. Inventory thresholds check resource or item possession; equipment predicates accept an item in a specified slot; counters capture events such as an entity defeat; snapshot comparisons read a named observation field. These primitives cover both simple item goals and objectives that combine player state with local environmental conditions.

paragraphs.en: The evaluator checks the initial snapshot before requesting an action. If all predicates already hold, the stage passes with zero steps. Otherwise, it checks after each environment transition until success, a mission failure, environment termination, or budget exhaustion. A stage limit is the smaller of its catalog budget and any configured cap. The normal chain runner stops at the first non-passing stage, preserving the distinction between the observed prefix and unattempted suffix.

paragraphs.en: Four mission-event definitions extend the basic predicates with observation-derived conditions. Their triggers combine local perception, lighting, elapsed time, and entity events. paragraphs.en: The probe configuration imposes a 450-step ceiling on each stage, retaining a lower catalog limit if one exists. The fixed-exposure source runner is enabled by experiment.source_interaction_budget_steps . Source exposure is measured as actual environment interactions. If a source episode ends before its family budget is consumed, the agent receives normal terminal feedback, the source environment resets, and interaction resumes with the persistent method artifact. The last episode is truncated at the remaining budget. Thus early completion or failure changes the number of episodes without reducing the prescribed source exposure. The source report records every episode and the total interaction count; a final paired comparison requires all three source conditions to consume the common budget.

paragraphs.en: MC-EvoBench connects policies to a common chain runner through a policy factory, a reset operation, and an action function. At each interaction, the adapter supplies the task instruction and current observation and receives a MineRL action mapping. The default prompt template is the instruction itself. Optional callbacks provide stage status and the number of executed steps, allowing methods with persistent memory to update after source experience. Table E.1 specifies the implemented method variants and their effective inputs; these interfaces define the observation, action, and persistent-state conditions used in each comparison. The table documents supported adapters; the headline reference study reported in the main paper uses only the JARVIS-1 online extension, while the other entries do not contribute to the paired-transfer results.
paragraphs.zh: MC-EvoBench 通过策略工厂、重置操作和行动函数，将策略连接到一个通用的链式运行器。 在每次交互中，适配器会提供任务说明和当前观察结果，并接收一个 MineRL 行动映射。 默认的提示模板就是任务说明本身。 可选的回调函数可提供阶段状态和已执行步骤的数量，使具有持久记忆的方法能够在获取源经验后进行更新。 表 E.1 列出了所实现的算法变体及其有效输入；这些接口定义了每次比较中使用的观察、行动和持久状态的条件。 该表格记录了支持的适配器；主论文中引用的基准研究仅使用了 JARVIS-1 在线扩展，而其他条目并未对成对迁移结果产生贡献。

VPT loads its network specification and policy-head settings from the model file; its sampling temperature is inherited from that file. Optimus-3 creates a task representation when the instruction changes, then combines it with successive frames.
paragraphs.zh: STEVE-1 和 JARVIS 控制器桥接器使用 MineCLIP 和一个已学习到的先验对文本进行编码，按提示缓存嵌入表示，并以引导尺度 6.0 重置条件控制器。 VPT 从模型文件中加载其网络规格和策略头设置；其采样温度也继承自该文件。 当指令发生变化时，Optimus-3 会创建一个任务表示，然后将其与后续帧结合。

paragraphs.en: The JARVIS online extension stores stage-level textual records containing the instruction, proposed plan, dispatched controller prompts, status, interaction count and visible-state summary. Retrieval uses token-set Jaccard similarity between the current instruction and each stored instruction, adds 0.15 for a successful record, and breaks score ties in favour of newer records. Up to four positive-scoring records condition planning. Memory retains the latest 256 records and is written atomically. The planner returns one to six short controller prompts; reflection produces a practical sentence capped at 500 characters. The reflection input distinguishes a proposed plan from prompts actually dispatched and labels the state summary as the last pre-action observation.
paragraphs.zh: JARVIS 在线扩展存储了阶段级的文本记录，其中包含指令、拟议计划、已调用的控制器提示、状态、交互次数和可见状态摘要。 检索过程通过计算当前指令与每条已存储指令之间的词元集雅可比相似度，对成功匹配的记录额外增加 0.15，并在分数相同时优先选择较新的记录。 最多四条得分正值的记录会影响规划。 内存保留最新的 256 条记录，并以原子方式写入。 规划器返回一到六个简短的控制器提示；反思过程会生成一个实用句子，长度上限为 500 个字符。 反思输入能够区分拟议计划与实际已调用的提示，并将状态摘要标记为行动前的最后观察结果。

paragraphs.en: ExpeL uses the same episode-retrieval score and supplements episodes with retrieved textual insights and a weighted rule list. Insight retrieval uses lexical overlap; rule retrieval adds a weight contribution capped at 0.10. With the configured insight limit of eight, the planner may receive up to eight insights and eight rules. Reflection proposes ADD, EDIT, REMOVE and AGREE operations. New rules start with weight two; agreement and editing increment weight, while removal decrements it. The persistent artifact records these updates alongside episode actions. Both memory methods support read-write source interaction and read-only target evaluation; read-only stage callbacks suppress reflection and memory writes.
paragraphs.zh: ExpeL 使用相同的剧集检索分数，并用检索到的文本洞察和加权规则列表对剧集进行补充。 洞察检索采用词汇重叠方式；规则检索则增加一个权重贡献值，上限为 0.10。 在配置了八个洞察限制的情况下，规划器最多可接收八个洞察和八条规则。 反思会提出 ADD、EDIT、REMOVE 和 AGREE 操作。 新规则的初始权重为二；同意和编辑操作会增加权重，而移除操作则会减少权重。 持久化工件会将这些更新与剧集动作一同记录。 两种记忆方法都支持读写源交互和只读目标评估；只读阶段的回调会抑制反思和记忆写入。

paragraphs.en: The JARVIS extension plans when a new stage instruction becomes active. It dispatches successive subgoals for fixed 120-step intervals and retains the final subgoal for any remaining stage steps. Stage completion invalidates the active instruction so repeated task text can trigger a new plan. Optimus-1’s visual planner uses the same interval rule and a JSON subgoal format. Its input is a JPEG thumbnail bounded by 384 × \times 384 pixels at quality 85. The parser filters subgoals containing “open,” “place,” or “access” followed by a space, rewrites punch/collect/gather to chop, and retains up to six subgoals. ExpeL instead requests a low-level action mapping and can hold that action across a configured number of environment steps. The 19-chain configuration sets this hold to 32, while the factory default is one. Its prompt also supplies explicit line-of-sight guidance for approaching and mining visible resources.
paragraphs.zh: JARVIS 扩展会规划新阶段指令何时生效。 它会以固定的 120 步间隔派发连续子目标，并将最终子目标保留用于任何剩余阶段步骤。 阶段完成会使当前指令失效，这样重复的任务文本就能触发新的计划。 Optimus-1 的视觉规划器使用相同的间隔规则和 JSON 子目标格式。 其输入是一个 JPEG 缩略图，尺寸限制为 384 × 384 像素，质量设为 85。 解析器会过滤包含“open”、“place”或“access”后跟空格的子目标，将 punch/collect/gather 改写为 chop，并保留最多六个子目标。 ExpeL 则会请求一个低级别动作映射，并且可以在设定的环境步骤数内保持该动作有效。 19 链配置将此保持时间设为 32，而工厂默认值为 1。 其提示还提供了明确的视线引导，用于接近和采集可见资源。

paragraphs.en: The Voyager skill bridge follows a separate execution protocol. The runner loads released JavaScript skills and control primitives, resets through the Mineflayer bridge with empty inventory and equipment, and invokes a fixed skill sequence. A configured starting position is applied during setup. The runner checks the returned inventory for its designated target item. Its step count denotes a bridge request, and the implementation invokes no LLM; this execution unit is recorded separately from MineRL interaction steps.
paragraphs.zh: 旅行者技能桥遵循独立的执行协议。 运行者加载已发布的 JavaScript 技能和控制原语，通过 Mineflayer 桥接器以空物品栏和装备状态重置，并调用固定的技能序列。 在设置阶段会应用一个配置好的起始位置。 运行者检查返回的物品栏中是否存在其指定的目标物品。 其步数表示一次桥接请求，且该实现不调用任何 LLM；此执行单元与 MineRL 交互步骤分开记录。

paragraphs.en: The ExpeL adaptation uses separate system templates for selecting an environment action and extracting reusable experience. Cards G.3 and G.3 specify the action and reflection interfaces. The action payload contains instruction , observation , experiences , and insights . The final field combines insight text with retrieved rules formatted as [ExpeL rule weight=...] ... . This representation exposes the rule’s persistence weight alongside its content. The observation is the structured state summary supplied by the adapter.
paragraphs.zh: ExpeL 适配通过独立的系统模板来选择环境动作并提取可重用的经验。 G.3 和 G.3 卡片分别定义了动作接口与反思接口。 动作负载包含指令、观察结果、经验和见解。 最后一个字段将见解文本与检索到的规则结合，格式为 [ExpeL 规则权重=...] ...。 这种表示方式同时展示了规则的持久性权重及其内容。 观察结果是适配器提供的结构化状态摘要。

paragraphs.en: The action parser accepts a mapping directly or JSON text, including a fenced JSON response. It accepts either a nested action mapping or the mapping itself. paragraphs.en: Reflection receives the stage episode: instruction , status , steps , actions , visible_state , visible_state_timing , and method . The state is explicitly labeled as the last pre-action observation, and the action list includes each returned action, including repetitions. The reflection parser accepts insight or reflection for the insight, and operations or rules for the operation list. It normalizes the response into insight text and rule operations. The prompt requests up to four rule operations per reflection.

paragraphs.en: The following pseudocode summarizes the common orchestration contract. Source interaction, artifact persistence, environment reset, and target evaluation are separate operations. paragraphs.en: At the task level, evaluation first observes the initial state, then alternates action and predicate evaluation until a terminal condition is reached. At the chain level, the runner applies the selected profile policy and records the first non-passing stage. At the experiment level, matched roles are combined within a seed before aggregation. These layers align environment execution, task success, and experience comparison at their respective units of analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务层面，评估首先观察初始状态，然后交替执行动作和谓词评估，直到达到终止条件。 在链式层面，运行器应用所选的配置文件策略，并记录第一个未通过的阶段。 在实验层面，匹配的角色会在聚合前于一个种子内组合起来。 这些层级在其各自的分析单元上对齐了环境执行、任务成功和体验比较。

paragraphs.en: Catalog validation checks the task definitions and compiled chains. A dry run then exercises the reporting path with the repository’s diagnostic adapter. Card G.6 runs from the appendix bundle directory and resolves the catalog through the companion path map.
